1.en: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -

2.en: Created man from a clinging substance.

3.en: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

5.en: Taught man that which he knew not.

8.en: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

9.en: Have you seen the one who forbids

11.en: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

13.en: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

14.en: Does he not know that Allah sees?

15.ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
15.en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -

17.en: Then let him call his associates;

18.en: We will call the angels of Hell.

19.en: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
